projects.title: Innovator-VL: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Scientific Discovery
projects.summary:
Project Overview: Led the development of a multimodal large language model designed for the scientific domain, open-sourcing Innovator-VL-8B-Instruct (general interaction) and Innovator-VL-8B-Thinking (deep reasoning), aiming to improve cross-disciplinary scientific understanding and reasoning.
Full-Pipeline Architecture: Built a fully transparent, end-to-end reproducible training pipeline from data cleaning, pre-training and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to reinforcement learning (RL). Optimized distributed training based on Megatron-LM, achieving efficient training throughput.
Extreme Data Efficiency: Broke the traditional paradigm of relying on massive domain pre-training data. Through principled data filtering strategies, reached SOTA on multiple scientific and general vision benchmarks with only fewer than 5 million high-quality scientific samples.
RL Alignment (RLHF): For the Thinking model, introduced the GSPO algorithm and a hierarchical reward mechanism, significantly strengthening multi-step reasoning (CoT); reasoning token efficiency improved 1.4× to 4.3× over comparable models (e.g. Intern-S1-mini).
Open-Source Impact: Gained 100+ GitHub Stars and 2000+ HuggingFace downloads shortly after release. Overall performance surpassed mainstream models such as Qwen3-VL-8B and InternVL3.5-8B across 37 benchmarks including Scientists' First Exam and MathVista.
Links: [GitHub] [Project Page]

projects.title: AI for Service: Proactive Assistance with AI Glasses
projects.summary:
Architecture Innovation: Proposed the Alpha-Service framework and a "Trigger-Analysis-Reasoning" three-level multi-agent architecture; through modular perception–decision–memory design and large/small model cascade scheduling, achieved a balance between low latency and high performance on edge devices.
Deployment: Built applications such as a game advisor and navigation guide on Xiaomi AI glasses, solving the "when to intervene" and "service strategy" problems of proactive service; the system accurately understands user intent and proactively offers assistance.
Links: [arXiv]

research.title: Activating Proactive Streaming Interaction in Video LLMs without Architectural Changes
research.summary:
Background: Addressing the core decision challenge that existing offline video LLMs (VideoLLMs) lack real-time interaction capability (i.e. not knowing "when" to speak), proposed a new paradigm that activates streaming video understanding without modifying the model architecture.
Streaming Evaluation Framework (RealStreamEval): Built the first evaluation framework that models streaming video understanding as frame-level multi-turn dialogue; by introducing a strict redundancy penalty mechanism, it forces the model to decide response timing autonomously in real-time streams, solving traditional evaluation's dependence on external polling or offline segments.
Self-Evolving Data Synthesis (EvoStreaming): Designed a zero-human-annotation self-evolving data generation pipeline; through a five-stage pipeline of "task classification – self-questioning – spatio-temporal anchoring – streaming trajectory synthesis – iterative refinement", uses the model's own capability to generate high-quality interaction signals. With only 1,000 self-generated samples, successfully activated streaming interaction in mainstream offline models such as Qwen2-VL and InternVL.
Performance Breakthrough: Without sacrificing the offline model's general performance, achieved stronger streaming interaction using only 1/100 the data of prior methods, improving by up to 10.8% on OVO-Bench. This work reveals that existing video models already possess latent streaming understanding ability, and the core bottleneck is the lack of correct interaction-timing training signals.
Role: First Author
Status: Under Review [arXiv]

research.title: Accelerating Streaming Video Understanding via Hierarchical Token Compression
research.summary:
Background: Targeting the compute bottleneck of rapidly growing ViT encoding time in streaming video understanding, proposed a plug-and-play, training-free hierarchical acceleration framework (STC), breaking the limitation that traditional compression methods depend on future information or user instructions and achieving full-pipeline acceleration.
Core Algorithms: Designed STC-Cacher, which uses a Scatter-Update strategy to compute only dynamic tokens and reuse the static background (avoiding 85% visual redundancy); proposed the instruction-free STC-Pruner, which precisely removes redundant features before the LLM based on dual-anchor spatio-temporal novelty.
Performance Breakthrough: On four mainstream baselines including ReKV and Dispider, while maintaining 99% accuracy, STC reduced ViT encoding latency by 24.5% and LLM pre-fill latency by 45.3%, significantly outperforming existing SOTA compression methods such as ToMe and VidCom².
Role: Core Contributor
Status: Under Review [arXiv]
